instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: PropTech startup operating a platform for fractional real estate investment allowing retail investors to invest in commercial properties with as little as €100. With 15,000 registered investors and €25M in funded properties, the company operates under CMVM oversight but benefits from a relatively streamlined regulatory landscape compared to highly sensitive financial markets. It is currently evaluating automated property sourcing and due diligence tools to scale operations.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality, resulting in an MVP built quickly but facing disappointing adoption (8% account creation). Key learnings showed that we invested too heavily in the front-end before validating the specific operational pain points of our retail investor demographic.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next two years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows.
answers.additionalContext: New data localization requirements in our second-largest market will force us to re-architect our cloud infrastructure within 12 months. Innovation initiatives must be sequenced around this mandatory work or find ways to turn the migration itself into a modernization opportunity.
answers.teamSize: We have a dedicated innovation squad of 8 people — 4 engineers, 1 data scientist, 1 UX designer, 1 product manager, and a part-time business analyst. This team operates with its own sprint cadence separate from the core product teams and has an allocated annual innovation budget. They report progress quarterly to the executive committee.

opportunities.title: Workflow Automation for Order Processing
opportunities.rationale: Implementing low-cost RPA (Robotic Process Automation) tools or micro-automation within the invoicing and order fulfillment pipeline can directly address operational inefficiencies without requiring massive upfront capital expenditure. This aligns perfectly with the strategic goal of reducing operating expenses through process optimization.

first_actions: Map current manual order processing workflow to identify 3 high-friction touchpoints.
Pilot a no-code automation tool (e.g., Zapier or internal scripting) for automated invoice generation.
resources_needed: Subscription fee for low-code automation tool (€1k/year)
Time commitment from 1 engineer (50 hours allocated)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in order processing cycle time by 20% within the first quarter.
milestones: Q1: Identify and prototype solution for invoicing automation.
Q2: Full integration of automated invoicing module.

opportunities.title: Customer Journey Optimization via Targeted Self-Service
opportunities.rationale: Instead of a full portal build, focus on incremental improvements to the most used manual support channels (e.g., FAQ bots or guided intake forms) that address specific investor queries found in NPS feedback. This low-risk approach validates customer needs before investing in major digital infrastructure.

first_actions: Analyze top 10 recurring questions from NPS surveys related to onboarding.
Implement a basic, guided FAQ chatbot on the existing website.
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease in support ticket volume related to onboarding by 15%.
milestones: Q3: Launch and iterate on the guided intake form.
Q4: Measure impact against previous manual support costs.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Property Due Diligence Scoring Tool (Bold Opportunity)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a bold predictive model using machine learning to automate the initial screening of commercial properties based on location, zoning data, and macro economic indicators. This would dramatically reduce manual due diligence time, allowing the small team to focus their talent resources on high-value negotiation rather than entry-level data aggregation.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated data science task force focused solely on sourcing external real estate datasets.
Define KPI metrics for 'deal quality' that the AI must predict.
resources_needed: Cloud computing resources for model training (€5k initial spend)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 10% increase in successful property acquisition rates using the AI scoring tool within one year.
milestones: Q2: Data pipeline construction and initial ML model training.
Q4: Integration of the predictive scoring engine into the sourcing workflow.

next_steps.action: Conduct a detailed process audit focusing solely on manual workflows in order processing and identify the top three automation candidates.
Allocate budget for the pilot program of workflow automation (Opportunity 1) and secure vendor selection.
Define data requirements and feasibility study for the AI-Driven Due Diligence Scoring Tool to assess technical viability.

key_weaknesses: Heavy reliance on manual workflows and spreadsheets, leading to high operational drag.
Inconsistent digital maturity across teams, creating siloed pockets of automation rather than systemic efficiency gains.
Limited upfront investment in deeply understanding specific customer needs before building scalable solutions.
Talent constraints regarding specialized data science skills needed for radical innovation initiatives.
